review_type: Pocock specification axis — target-measurement precision delta
scope: Specification intent and authorised scope only. Naming and standards were not assessed.
requirement_refs: Spec:819-825 requires accessible controls and no clipping; spec:855-868 preserves the 512-audit, 324-layout-only, 836-case matrix and forbids an audit exception.
Spec:913-915 and 1161-1168 require native audit results with no unresolved accessibility failure.
Spec:944-946 requires XCTest UI journeys and forbids tests of private Swift helpers.
Spec:1347-1355 requires reachable controls, named screenshots, native settings evidence, and actual image inspection.
Spec:1414-1426 preserves the full programme and rejects unsupported inference from XCTest attachments.
Plan:33 and 61-65 preserve unrestricted audits and prohibit conversion of a failed native result into a pass.

assessment.subject: 44-point target policy
assessment.rationale: The implementation retains the 44-point minimum. It accepts only a finite value within 1e-9 point below that minimum. It rejects NaN and infinity, and does not change application target sizing.

assessment.subject: Failure diagnostics and action reachability
assessment.rationale: Hittability remains mandatory. Width and height checks remain separate. Diagnostics now retain both exact frame dimensions, the minimum, and the precision policy.

assessment.subject: Evidence and masking
assessment.rationale: The retained diagnostic records 43.99999999999966 for a source-defined 44-point target, a 3.41e-13 deficit. The change is a bounded test-comparison correction. It does not suppress accessibility audits, alter capture, runner behaviour, coverage counts, or the app target minimum.

verdict: PASS — the finite 1e-9 precision band preserves the 44-point policy for the documented numerical-comparison fault. No specification-scope leak or audit masking was found. This does not claim knowledge of Apple arithmetic or native, pilot, UI, or final acceptance.
retained_limitations: The reported ten boundary checks and rejection of larger undersizes were not rerun by this review.
Native focus remains active. The 22-case pilot, full 836-case programme, audit results, image inspection, and final gates remain pending.
Historical Copy-contrast and Settings missed-tap causes remain unresolved.
